|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may ▼spy Artoo (deploy -2). During your control phase, if Artoo at same site as a captive Leia, may use 1 Force to release her (you retrieve no Force this turn). While Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself on table, Battle Order is suspended where Leia is present. (Immune to This Is Some Rescue.)[Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Cell 2187 (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may deploy spy R2-D2 (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your control phase, if R2-D2 is with captive Leia, may use 1 Force to release her. While Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself on table, where Leia present, ignore Battle Order. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “▼spy Artoo (deploy -2).” → “deploy spy R2-D2 (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “Artoo at same site as a” → “R2-D2 is with”; “her (you retrieve no Force this turn).” → “her.”; removed “Battle Order is suspended”; “is present.” → “present, ignore Battle Order. May not be canceled.”; “This Is Some Rescue.)[Immune to Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
